ZomCalypse: 更好的喪屍末日

Welcome to ZomCalypse, a hardcore zombie apocalypse modpack designed to turn your Minecraft world into a gradual difficulty, desolate, and terrifying. The civilization has fallen, cities are ruined, and the dead walk the earth. Your only goal? Survive.

Features:

 🏚️ Exploration & World Generation

  • Decaying Metropolis: Explore huge abandoned cities and apocalyptic buildings.
  • Destroyed Landmarks: Stumble upon Abandoned Structures, military checkpoints, forgotten churches, radio towers, and rare airdrops containing important loot.
  • Ruined Terrain: Experience the world's beautiful terrain but has begun to decay and is overgrown with wild plants. 

 🔫 Tactical Combat & Gun shooting

  • Next-Gen Gun Play: Lock and load with Timeless Guns and Classics Zero (TaCZ), which offer highly detailed firearm mechanics, sleek reload animations, and in-depth bullet upgrades.
  • Advanced Gear & Weaponry: Customize your weapons using advanced tactical gear.
  • Audio-Visual Overhaul: Experience every shot with realistic bullet dust impacts and improved visual response during bloody battles.
